source.citation: D. Watanabe et al., 'Combustion Stability Improvement of LE-9 Engine for Booster Stage of H3 Launch Vehicle', Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Technical Review Vol. 53 No. 4 (Aralik 2016), s.30 Tablo 1 (LE-7A karsilastirma sutunu)
source.extraction_note: Sayilar MHI Technical Review 53(4) PDF Tablo 1 LE-7A sutunundan dogrudan okundu (https://www.mhi.com/technology/review/sites/g/files/jwhtju2326/files/tr/pdf/e534/e534028.pdf): vakum itki 1098 kN, MR 5.9, oda basinci 12.3 MPa (ana yanma odasi), Isp 440 s, genisleme orani 47, cevrim 'two-stage combustion cycle' (= yakit-zengin kademeli yanma). units_original: kN, s, MPa, - (MHI Technical Review 53(4) Tablo 1 orijinal birimleri)
notes: H-IIA/H-IIB 1. kademe ana motoru (JAXA/MHI). 12.3 MPa 'main combustion chamber' basincidir (MHI Tablo 1 dipnotu). MHI 'two-stage combustion cycle' = yakit-zengin kademeli yanma; HRMA cevrimi 'staged_combustion'. Yuksek Pc + genisleme 47 = 1. kademe. Ikincil kaynaklarda genisleme orani 51.9 dolasir; MHI birincil tablosu 47 verir, 47 kullanildi.
